name: stylua
description: Opinionated Lua code formatter enforcing consistent style across Lua 5.1-5.4, LuaJIT, and Luau codebases

stylua.description: Deterministic Lua code formatter that parses and reprints code with consistent style enforcement
stylua.usage:
stylua src/ # Format all Lua files in directory
stylua script.lua # Format single file
stylua --check src/ # Check formatting without modifying
stylua --verify src/ # Verify files are formatted correctly
stylua --config-path=.stylua.toml src/ # Use custom config
stylua --column-width=100 script.lua # Set line width
